<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~126.092 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical high‑resolution tolerance is C₇H₁₀O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H10O2</final_answer>
